title: sdr-daily-scratchpad-maya-singh-2026-03-16
body:
Daily scratchpad for 2026-03-16

Goals for today:
- 30 calls minimum
- 12 connected conversations
- 6 qualified MQLs
- Book 3 discovery meetings (AE)

Morning plan (9:00 - 11:30)
- Warm-up: 9:00-9:20 follow-up emails (template A)
- 9:25 - 10:30: Target account list A (see reps below)
- 10:40 - 11:30: LinkedIn touch + voicemails

Afternoon plan (13:00 - 17:30)
- 13:00 - 14:30: Inbound follow-ups (HubSpot queue)
- 14:45 - 16:00: Sequence outbound calls to high-fit accounts
- 16:15 - 17:00: Cadence updates + log dispositions
- 17:00 - 17:30: Outreach recap + prep for tomorrow

Call list (priority order):
1) NimbusHealth (CTO Emma Brooks) - pain: latency on in-app notes, wants predictable inference cost. Call to qualify infra/paid? Pitch Dedicated.
2) Ledgerlytics (Head of ML: Raj Patel) - running open models on prem, curious about Redwood Private. Ask about compliance & KMS.
3) Cartwise (VP Eng: Ana Gomez) - evaluating hosted APIs, cost concerns. Offer Optimize recommendations and trial credits.
4) BrightRoutes (Director Data: Tom Lee) - interested in embeddings for search, ask about throughput and demo.
5) OmniRetail (Head of Platform: Sarah Nguyen) - long sales cycle, re-engage after webinar.

Follow-ups (urgent):
- Alice @ Nimbus: promised a demo link by EOD last Fri. Follow up and propose Tue or Wed next week.
- Raj @ Ledgerlytics: send Private deployment checklist + compliance brief. Attach KMS FAQ.
- Tom @ BrightRoutes: send short benchmark doc (p95 latency on g4dn vs p4) and availability for trial.

Notes from yesterday's calls:
- Cartwise: CFO worried about monthly spend spikes. Suggest dedicated capacity simulation to show predictability. Next: schedule ROI calc session with product.
- OmniRetail: procurement cycle 3-6 months, tiered rollout. Keep low-touch nurture.

Email templates to use:
- Template A: "Quick follow-up — Redwood trial + benchmark" (use for inbound warm leads)
- Template B: "Private deployment checklist" (for compliance conversations)

Tasks / CRM actions:
- Log all call dispositions in HubSpot by EOD (Call, Left voicemail, No answer, Interested)
- Create Deal for NimbusHealth; set stage = Demo Scheduled
- Add Raj to Private-deployments nurture list

Risks / blockers:
- Need updated benchmark PDF from SRE team (ping Elena Z.)
- Pricing sheet outdated (finance review). Use conservative numbers in calls and flag for follow-up.

Metrics tracker (today):
- Calls placed: 0
- Connected: 0
- Meetings booked: 0
- MQLs created: 0

Quick reminders:
- Bring up canary fallback on calls where they worry about uptime
- Highlight per-token cost controls (batching + quantization) with technical buyers
- Ask about current provider and top 2 pain points

End-of-day notes (fill in after EOD):
- Summary of connects / booked meetings
- Blockers to push to AE
- Follow-up cadence for next 3 days

Slack threads / refs:
- #g2m-sdr - thread about new outbound list (see pinned message)
- Confluence: /outreach/q2-playbook (link in linked_artifacts)

TODO (today):
- [ ] Send Nimbus demo invite
- [ ] Email Raj Private checklist
- [ ] Update HubSpot dispositions
- [ ] Request benchmark PDF from SRE

Quick scripts (30s intro):
"Hi {{first_name}}, this is Maya from Redwood Inference. We help teams reduce LLM inference cost and stabilize latency in production — quick question: who owns inference/ML infra there?"

Disposition key:
- Interested = schedule discovery
- Nurture = add to sequence
- No budget = add to long-term nurture
- Not a fit = close
